slices.behaviour: One function answers whether a slice's plan covers a path: normalise and covers live in harness/paths.py, calibration imports them back, and guard.py, triage.py's _slice_files_check and triage.py's file_facts all call covers instead of comparing exactly. The fourth of those was F1 of the first review.
slices.failure_reason: NoSecondReaderTest's two new cases failed against the instrument as it stood: test_a_reader_in_a_module_nobody_listed_is_seen errored because the scope was a four-name allowlist with no _modules to ask, and test_a_comparator_wrapped_in_a_fallback_is_seen failed with 'AssertionError: Lists differ: [] != [2]' because the comparator "entry.get('files') or []" is not the unparsed text the exact match looked for. The earlier reds of this slice are records 6, 7, 8, 22, 29 and 36.
